info.title: Delivery Plus Admin API
info.description: Staff admin contract for the Delivery Plus platform (#212). Each service owns its own /admin routes; the gateway publishes them under /api/admin/<service>. Requires a staff JWT (role ADMIN) carrying the route's permissions; SYSTEM tokens are refused with 401. Every mutation requires a reason and goes through the audit hook (#213).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A full order id; anything else matches nothing.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: active = not finished, completed = DELIVERED, cancelled = CANCELLED or FAILED.

401.description: Missing or invalid JWT, or a SYSTEM token on an admin route

403.description: Staff token without the required permission
